title: Little more than a task list.
body: More annoying than useful really. It’s just a task list with reminders and a “streak” mechanic. The same could be achieved with a kanban board without it flooding your phone with “quirky” notifications. Not really oriented to or based on research of ADHD, so it shouldn’t be marketed that way.
